A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The warlord entered into a deal with the Empire where he would receive weapons and support in exchange for his loyalty, but once he had eliminated his competition, the warlord's ambitions led him to break his deal with the Empire. However, an Imperial individual convinced the alien's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] to turn on him, and the lieutenants cooperated with the Empire.<ref name="Broken Promises" />
